variables_or_content: AM/PM surface soil-moisture retrievals and quality flags
limitations: Surface soil moisture; coarse relative to fields; retrieval quality affected by vegetation and surface conditions; not nutrients or direct root-zone moisture

product_or_collection: ECO_L3G_JET and applicable Collection 2 LST products
variables_or_content: evapotranspiration, evaporative stress indicators and land-surface temperature; product-specific
nominal_spatial_resolution: about 70 m for selected ET product; varies by product
limitations: Irregular observations, cloud masks and product-specific algorithms; not a continuous daily time series; verify exact collection/product guide

role: precipitation totals intensity dry spells and extreme-rainfall context
authentication: Earthdata Login for many bulk workflows
limitations: Choose Final for retrospective analysis; Early/Late are lower latency; estimates are not rain gauges; check units and quality fields

product_or_collection: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance and Surface Temperature
variables_or_content: surface reflectance bands, vegetation indices derived from bands, surface temperature and QA
nominal_spatial_resolution: 30 m multispectral; thermal product grid/resolution is product-specific
temporal_resolution: nominal 16-day per satellite; constellation revisit varies
role: field/land-cover vegetation and thermal change analysis
access_method: USGS EarthExplorer / LandsatLook / Earth Engine / STAC
authentication: depends on access route; Earthdata not normally required for USGS access
limitations: Cloud, shadow, aerosol and saturation QA essential; Landsat surface temperature has retrieval limitations; mixed pixels and revisit gaps

variables_or_content: NDVI EVI vegetation-index QA and pixel reliability
role: seasonal vegetation condition and anomaly tracking
limitations: Quality flags must be applied; vegetation indices are proxies, not direct crop identity or yield

variables_or_content: temperature precipitation humidity solar radiation and other available parameters; confirm parameter names and units
role: meteorological and solar context for seasonal features
limitations: Parameter provenance and source resolution vary; not all variables are direct satellite observations; point API is not a field-scale raster

product_or_collection: JPL RL06.3Mv04 or current documented mascon release; confirm latest version before acquisition
variables_or_content: terrestrial water-storage anomalies and uncertainty fields
nominal_spatial_resolution: 0.5 degree mascon grid (effective resolution is coarser)
role: regional and basin-scale long-term water-storage trends
limitations: Very coarse relative to farms; measures total water-storage change, not groundwater alone or field soil moisture; leakage and scaling uncertainties

product_or_collection: SRTM 1 Arc-Second Global (SRTMGL1) or current available collection
role: terrain elevation slope aspect and drainage derivatives
limitations: Acquisition-era surface; radar artifacts and voids; not a current terrain survey; inspect vertical datum and void handling
Reprocessed SRTM, not a new observation epoch; inspect source-index layer, vertical reference and remaining artifacts

role: terrain steepness and landform context for erosion/runoff screening
limitations: Derived from NASADEM rather than independent elevation measurements; slope/curvature depend on processing scale

role: independent DEM comparison and terrain backup
limitations: Can contain artifacts and residual errors; compare with NASADEM/SRTM and inspect water/void artifacts

variables_or_content: ground elevation canopy-top height and relative-height metrics from lidar waveforms
coverage_or_period: 2019-present with acquisition gaps; verify latest collection
limitations: Not a continuous wall-to-wall DEM; footprint sampling is sparse and uneven; canopy and ground metrics need careful interpretation

product_or_collection: GEDI L3 Gridded Land Surface Metrics V2 or current version
variables_or_content: mean ground elevation canopy height standard deviation and footprint counts
limitations: Gridded summary of sampled GEDI footprints, not a high-resolution continuous DEM; coverage limited to GEDI latitude range
